name: anatomix-t1w-dwi-registration
summary: Registers a DWI series to a T1-weighted image by aligning its mean b0 with anatomix deep features and FireANTs deformable registration, outputting the registered b0 and an ANTs-convention warp.
description: Averages the DWI volumes at or below b0_max_bval into a b0 image, registers it onto the T1w with anatomix-register.py (modality-agnostic anatomix features driving FireANTs, affine then deformable by default) and writes the resampled b0 plus the forward and optional inverse displacement fields in ITK/ANTs convention. Use the warp to bring FA/MD or other DWI-space maps into T1w space, or the inverse to bring T1w-space parcellations into DWI space. A GPU is strongly recommended; the transform must end in a deformable stage.

inputs.description: T1-weighted anatomical image used as the fixed image.
DWI series with bvals and bvecs; its mean b0 is the moving image.
inputs.requirements: At least one volume with b-value at or below b0_max_bval.

outputs.description: Mean b0 volume extracted from the DWI series, registered (resampled) onto the T1w grid.

FireANTs transform (ITK/ANTs LPS-mm displacement field convention, not FSL) that resamples the DWI/b0 (moving) image onto T1w (fixed) space -- apply it to other DWI-space volumes (e.g. FA, MD maps) to bring them into T1w space. With save_inverse enabled, inverse-warp.nii.gz does the reverse (T1w -> native DWI space).

parameters.description: b-value (s/mm^2) at or below which a DWI volume is treated as a b0 and averaged to build the moving image.

Comma-separated registration stages, in order, from rigid/affine/deformable (see anatomix-register.py --help). Must end in a deformable stage: this app's warp output is a NIfTI displacement field, which anatomix-register.py only writes when the last stage is deformable. affine,deformable handles gross T1w/DWI misalignment plus local distortion; use deformable alone if the images are already roughly aligned.
Also compute the moving-to-fixed (DWI/b0 -> T1w) inverse transform, e.g. to bring a T1w-space parcellation into native DWI space for tractography ROIs.
Compute device for FireANTs: auto, cpu, cuda, or cuda:N.

failure_modes.fix: Raise b0_max_bval or check the bvals file.
Make the transform parameter end in a deformable stage, e.g. affine,deformable.
